report_discrepancies.note: General Fund Total federal programs printed 296,936.77 but the printed federal lines (Title I, REAP, IDEA, Title IV, ESSER) add to 272,887.03; no missing line found on pp19-20. The grand total and function totals tie to the printed figure.

Statement of Activities function lines disagree with the General Fund schedule on where the 424,100 transfer to the Depreciation Fund sits: p2 Pupil transportation 586,547.34 equals the p19 transportation total, which includes '732 Transfer to depreciation fund' 200,000, while p2 Maintenance of plant 586,804.16 = GF 941,970.84 - the full 424,100 + Depreciation Fund supplies 68,933.32. So p2 overstates transportation and understates maintenance by 200,000; totals are unaffected. Printed figures kept (see decision_needed).

decision_needed.question: The report contradicts itself on which General Fund spending holds the 424,100 transfer to the Depreciation Fund. GF transportation (p19) prints a 200,000 'Transfer to depreciation fund', yet the Statement of Activities (p2) leaves pupil transportation unchanged at 586,547.34 and removes the full 424,100 from Maintenance of plant. Is the 200,000 transfer really in transportation (so only 224,100 comes out of maintenance), or is all 424,100 in maintenance of plant spending?
decision_needed.recorded_as: 200,000 left in transportation as an other financing line (p19); contra lines by function group: -40,000 instruction and -224,100 maintenance of plant, with matching other financing outflows; top-level receipts/disbursements come from the statement of activities, which excludes all 491,100 of transfers

notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds (incl. School Nutrition and Activities) are governmental activities, so business_type is null. Top-level receipts and disbursements are the lines of the Statement of Activities (p2): program receipts + general receipts = 12,306,019.53 and disbursements 13,706,578.63. The v7 re-trim added the governmental funds Statement of Fund Balances and Changes in Fund Balances (report pp9-10, trimmed pp3-4); its Governmental Funds total column prints the same totals (receipts 12,306,019.53, disbursements 13,706,578.63, beginning 7,891,175.66, ending 6,490,616.56, transfers eliminated in a Reclassification column), so the function-based Statement of Activities lines are kept. Its Federal receipts 784,046.30 and State receipts 5,729,965.27 confirm the grants split below. It prints principal 578,521.73 and interest/fees 925,299.40, classing Special Building BOK principal 113,000 and QCPU principal 40,000 as interest; the debt split here follows the fund schedules' principal codes (review on both lines). 'Operating Grants and Contributions' 1,410,606.08 is split into federal 784,046.30 and state 626,559.78 using the fund schedules (pp6, 11, 13). Statement 'Other' 52,383 is recorded as donations/contributions (97% donations: 50,000 + 683 + 1,700 from fund schedules; mix named in review). Transfers of 491,100 between funds (computed from pp8-10) are excluded from those and shown in transfers_in/transfers_out; printed totals on p5 (12,797,119.53 receipts, 14,197,678.63 disbursements) include them. Hidden General Fund transfers (264,100) are shown as two contra lines by function group (-40,000 instruction, -224,100 maintenance of plant) identified by comparing p2 with p7 function totals, plus matching other financing lines. 'Debt service and fees' (1,508,521.13) is split into principal and interest/fees using the fund schedules (pp12-14), which add exactly to the printed line. Detail: General Fund receipts from p6; General Fund spending by program and object from the operational expenses exhibit (pp15-20), which supersedes the function-only lines on p7 (not recorded). Activities Fund recorded account by account from p21 (replaces the one-line p10 schedule); transfers into accounts (27,000) recorded as other financing outside the printed total. Prior-year comparative columns (2024, p22) not recorded. Lines with zero actual are omitted (budget-only). Totals-only budget comparison on p5 not recorded as detail. 890 Other expense lines are marked miscellaneous expenditure with review. Fund balance roll-forward: 7,891,175.66 + 12,306,019.53 - 13,706,578.63 = 6,490,616.56. Read pages 1-22 of 22
